description.purpose: Monthly summaries of small-scale fishing activity per district, written by each country's pipeline for its Peskas dashboard.
description.usage: Written by peskas.coasts export_portal() after summarize_data(), every 2 days in Kenya and Mozambique and every 4 days in Zanzibar. Read by peskas.dashboard and, through the dashboard's /api/askfish routes, by AskFish. The metrics are defined in metrics.json.
description.limitations: Built from validated landings only. Recorded figures describe the surveyed landings, not the whole fleet; estimated figures scale them up to all the boats of a district.

servers.description: Zanzibar's dashboard (zanzibar.peskas.org). ZAFIRI enumerators survey landings in Unguja and Pemba; catch weight comes from fish number and length (FishBase length-weight) or buckets; one value covers the whole catch, so a species price comes only from trips that landed that species alone. Every measure from 2025-02. The ARTFISH days-fished question has been asked since 2025-08; earlier months use the district's average answer.

Kenya's dashboard (kenya.peskas.org). The KEFS catch assessment survey weighs the whole catch and identifies, weighs and prices a sample: catch by species is that sample, prices are per species, and mean_length is the mean of the fish measured on a landing. Recorded figures from 2024-01, FAO ARTFISH estimates from 2024-08, GPS tracker estimates and sampling_rate from 2025-03.
Mozambique's dashboard (mozambique.peskas.org). The DINAPA landing survey; weight and price as in Zanzibar. FAO ARTFISH groups boats by boat type alone. Every measure from 2025-10.

schema.name: monthly_summaries
schema.description: Every district-month metric except the counts, crew size and trip duration, which only districts_summaries carries. Its mean_* values are the same as in districts_summaries.
schema.dataGranularityDescription: One row per district, month and metric.

properties.name: gaul_2_name
properties.description: District: the official GAUL level 2 name. Districts are matched by name, never by code.

properties.name: date
properties.description: The month, as its first day at midnight UTC. The current month is in the data while its landings come in; views stop at the last complete month.

properties.name: metric
properties.description: The metric's key in metrics.json.

properties.name: value
properties.description: The measure's value; can be null.

value: Carries no landing counts: the landings that weight an average come from districts_summaries (n_submissions of the same district and month).

schema.name: districts_summaries
schema.description: Every district-month metric, with the landings surveyed, crew size and trip duration.
schema.dataGranularityDescription: One row per district, month and indicator.

properties.name: gaul_2_name
properties.description: District: the official GAUL level 2 name. Districts are matched by name, never by code.

properties.name: date
properties.description: The month, as its first day at midnight UTC. The current month is in the data while its landings come in; views stop at the last complete month.

properties.name: indicator
properties.description: The metric's key in metrics.json.

properties.name: value
properties.description: The measure's value; can be null.

value: A district-month with no landings has no row or a null value: it is a gap in data collection, not zero fishing.

schema.name: gear_summaries
schema.description: Landings and catch and revenue rates per gear.
schema.dataGranularityDescription: One row per district, month, gear and indicator.

properties.name: gaul_2_name
properties.description: District: the official GAUL level 2 name. Districts are matched by name, never by code.

properties.name: date
properties.description: The month, as its first day at midnight UTC. The current month is in the data while its landings come in; views stop at the last complete month.

properties.name: gear
properties.description: Fishing gear as the survey names it; missing for trips recorded without one.

properties.name: indicator
properties.description: n_submissions, or the gear name of a metric in metrics.json (cpue for mean_cpue, rpue for mean_rpue).

properties.name: value
properties.description: The measure's value; can be null.

value: Describes the surveyed landings: enumerators may visit some landing sites, and so some gears, more often than others.

schema.name: taxa_summaries
schema.description: Recorded catch, length and price per taxon, and the FAO ARTFISH estimate of each taxon's catch by all boats.
schema.dataGranularityDescription: One row per district, month, taxon and metric.

properties.name: gaul_2_name
properties.description: District: the official GAUL level 2 name. Districts are matched by name, never by code.

properties.name: date
properties.description: The month, as its first day at midnight UTC. The current month is in the data while its landings come in; views stop at the last complete month.

properties.name: catch_taxon
properties.description: Taxon: the scientific name of a species, genus or family; empty for unidentified catch. taxa_traits links it to its ASFIS code.

properties.name: metric
properties.description: The metric's key under taxaMetrics in metrics.json.

properties.name: value
properties.description: The measure's value; can be null.

value: Recorded catch by taxon is the catch of the surveyed landings only, a small part of the total; in Kenya it is the identified sample of each catch.
Some taxa are recorded at family or genus level.

schema.name: gear_taxa_summaries
schema.description: Recorded catch per gear and taxon: what each gear lands. Since coasts 4.15.0.
schema.dataGranularityDescription: One row per district, month, gear and taxon; only rows with catch.

properties.name: gaul_2_name
properties.description: District: the official GAUL level 2 name. Districts are matched by name, never by code.

properties.name: date
properties.description: The month, as its first day at midnight UTC. The current month is in the data while its landings come in; views stop at the last complete month.

properties.name: gear
properties.description: Fishing gear as the survey names it; missing for trips recorded without one.

properties.name: catch_taxon
properties.description: Taxon: the scientific name of a species, genus or family; empty for unidentified catch. taxa_traits links it to its ASFIS code.

properties.name: catch_kg
properties.description: Recorded catch of the taxon by the gear at surveyed landings. Adds up.

properties.name: n_trips
properties.description: Surveyed trips with the gear that landed the taxon. A trip that landed several taxa counts in each, so trips do not add up across taxa.

schema.name: length_summaries
schema.description: Recorded catch per length class, for the size views. Since coasts 4.15.0. Classes: under 10 cm, 5 cm wide to 30 cm, 10 cm wide to 1 m, then 100-125, 125-150, 150-200 and 200 cm or more.
schema.dataGranularityDescription: One row per district, month, taxon, gear and length class; only measured catch.

properties.name: gaul_2_name
properties.description: District: the official GAUL level 2 name. Districts are matched by name, never by code.

properties.name: date
properties.description: The month, as its first day at midnight UTC. The current month is in the data while its landings come in; views stop at the last complete month.

properties.name: catch_taxon
properties.description: Taxon: the scientific name of a species, genus or family; empty for unidentified catch. taxa_traits links it to its ASFIS code.

properties.name: gear
properties.description: Fishing gear as the survey names it; missing for trips recorded without one.

properties.name: length_min
properties.description: Lower edge of the length class, included.

properties.name: length_max
properties.description: Upper edge of the length class, excluded; missing for the open top class.

properties.name: n_trips
properties.description: Trips measured behind the taxon, gear, district and month, repeated on each of its length classes: count it once per taxon, gear, district and month.

properties.name: catch_kg
properties.description: Recorded catch in the length class. Adds up.

value: In Kenya a catch row carries the mean length of the fish measured on that landing, so classes hold landings' averages and understate the smallest and largest fish.
Size views use only species measured on at least 10 landings; shares below maturity are ranges, because a class can straddle the length at maturity.

schema.name: taxa_traits
schema.description: FishBase and SeaLifeBase traits of each taxon the country has landed, among the species recorded in FAO areas 51 and 57. A code spanning several species takes their median and range; the species-level fields are set only for a one-species code. Every trait is missing when FishBase had nothing. Since coasts 4.15.0.
schema.dataGranularityDescription: One row per taxon, for the whole country and all months.

properties.name: alpha3_code
properties.description: FAO ASFIS 3-alpha code of the taxon.

properties.name: catch_taxon
properties.description: Taxon: the scientific name of a species, genus or family; empty for unidentified catch. taxa_traits links it to its ASFIS code.

properties.name: english_name
properties.description: Common name from ASFIS.

properties.name: n_species
properties.description: Species the code spans.

properties.name: vulnerability
properties.description: FishBase intrinsic vulnerability to fishing, 0 to 100 (median over the code's species). The dashboard groups it in quarters: low, moderate, high, very high.

properties.name: vulnerability_min
properties.description: Lowest vulnerability among the code's species.

properties.name: vulnerability_max
properties.description: Highest vulnerability among the code's species.

properties.name: trophic_level
properties.description: Median FishBase trophic level: about 2 for plant eaters, 3 to 4.5 for predators.

properties.name: n_threatened
properties.description: Species of the code that are IUCN Vulnerable, Endangered or Critically Endangered.

properties.name: n_cites
properties.description: Species of the code listed by CITES.

properties.name: iucn_code
properties.description: IUCN Red List category, for a one-species code only. Global and can be years old.

properties.name: length_maturity_cm
properties.description: Total length at which the species first reproduces, for a one-species code only.

properties.name: length_optimum_cm
properties.description: Total length at which a year-class reaches its greatest total weight, for a one-species code only; kept only when at or above the length at maturity.

properties.name: class
properties.description: Taxonomic class; Elasmobranchii are sharks and rays.

value: Missing district-months are absent observations, not zero: a zero would claim the month was surveyed.
Every view stops at the last complete month: the current month is left out while its landings come in.
Figures resting on fewer than 10 landings are thin and can swing widely from one month to the next.
Recorded figures describe the surveyed landings, not the whole fleet.
Estimated figures exist only for district-months with at least 10 surveyed trips, and leave out fishing without boats, such as gleaning on foot.
Values are as reported at the landing site, not adjusted for inflation.
